t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally and Nick are playing up in their tree house when Nick's mum calls them in for lunch. Later, Nick and Sally play hide-and-seek and The Cat takes the kids to meet the best hider ever!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally wants to water the plants in her backyard but it's hot and sunny outside. Later, The Cat brings Nick and Sally to meet his friend, Slyde the Snake.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally are playing 'Pin the Tail on the Donkey' when they wish they had tails of their own! Later, Nick breaks his drumstick while he and Sally are playing the drums on overturned buckets...

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally are making shadow puppets with the Cat in the Hat when the batteries in the flashlight go out! Then, Nick, Sally and the Cat get invited along on a snail expedition!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally and Nick are pretending to fly in their backyard. Later, The Cat in the Hat takes Sally and Nick to Huff-Puff-Maguff!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally are planning to put on a show for their mums but they can't finish their dance without falling down! Later, Sally and Nick play a game of blindfolded tag.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally are pretending to be pirates. The Cat takes them on a real pirate adventure by following a treasure map! Later, The Cat takes them to met some expert tower builders: the termites!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Stan the Bower Bird, the World's Most Fantabulous Decorator, teaches Nick and Sally how to decorate with almost anything! Then, The Cat takes them to meet the best holder-on-ever: Larry the Limpet!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally can't jump high enough to get their balloon that is stuck up in a tree. Later, The Cat takes the kids to meet Onslow the sloth.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: The Cat takes Nick and Sally to Color-ga-lore to meet King Kaleidoscope, an expert on rainbows! Later, Nick and Sally are enjoying a picnic when they discover their last strawberry has gone missing!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Sally and Nick are so excited to go ice skating tomorrow that they can't fall asleep! Then, the Cat in the Hat takes the kids to meet Dr. Twiggles, the tree doctor.

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick and Sally are playing in their homemade Thingamajigger when the Cat arrives to take them on a real adventure! Later, The Cat takes them to meet Zhu Zhu, a giant panda!

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: Nick is trying to make his mother a surprise lunch but she keeps coming into the kitchen! Later, Nick can't remember where he put his yoyo...

t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
d: The Cat takes Nick and Sally to Finola's Farm to have breakfast with Finola. After, it's Valentine's Day, and Nick and Sally disagree hotly on how to decorate the card they're making for the Cat.
